# Shaunak Chorge - AI Engineer at Claptek Pvt Ltd (Mumbai, India)

> Shaunak Chorge is an AI Engineer at Claptek Pvt Ltd in Mumbai, India. He holds a Bachelor of Technology in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. He builds AI chatbots that answer from your own documents, Python backend APIs, and computer vision and speech models. He also takes select freelance AI and backend projects alongside his full-time job.

Facts: role AI Engineer; employer Claptek Pvt Ltd; location Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (IST, UTC+5:30); education Bachelor of Technology in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Dr. D. Y. Patil School of Science and Technology; takes select freelance AI and backend projects.
Contact: https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/contact/ - shaunak.chorge@gmail.com
Profiles: https://github.com/ShaunakChorge - https://www.linkedin.com/in/shaunak-chorge - https://www.instagram.com/_shaunakkk/

## Hire (freelance services)

- [Freelance AI chatbot developer for document assistants](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/services/llm-rag-development/): Hire a freelance AI chatbot developer in Mumbai. Chatbots that answer from your own documents, show their sources and say "I do not know" when unsure.
- [Document data extraction with AI](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/services/ai-document-compliance-automation/): Freelance document AI: tools that read PDFs and forms and pull out clean data, with a quote from the source for each fact and checks on AI drafts.
- [Hire a FastAPI developer for Python backends and APIs](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/services/ai-backend-fastapi-django/): Hire a freelance FastAPI and Django developer in Mumbai. Python backend APIs with PostgreSQL, Docker, automated tests and logs for fast debugging.
- [Computer vision development services](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/services/computer-vision/): Freelance computer vision developer in Mumbai. Tools that detect, count and classify things in photos and video with OpenCV, PyTorch and YOLOv8.
- [Machine learning model development for speech, text and data](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/services/speech-nlp-ml/): Freelance machine learning developer in Mumbai. Models that learn from audio, text or spreadsheet data, with accuracy tested on your data and a web app.
- [Python automation services: scrapers, bots and integrations](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/services/python-automation-integrations/): Freelance Python automation in Mumbai: web scrapers, Telegram and WhatsApp bots and tool-to-tool links, with background jobs, error handling and logs.

## Case studies
- [All projects](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/): Selected AI chatbot, computer vision, speech and Python backend projects by Shaunak Chorge, with case studies, results and the tools behind each one.
- [Healthcare RAG chatbot that cites its sources](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/ai-rag-healthcare-assistant/): Case study: a chatbot using FastAPI, ChromaDB and Groq that answers from six made-up health policies, cites its source and refuses off-topic questions.
- [CCTV video analytics in Python: crowds, crime and faces](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/advanced-cctv-analytics/): Case study: a Smart India Hackathon team project that watches one CCTV video three ways: crowd-limit alerts, crime labels and face recognition.
- [Speech emotion recognition project](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/speech-emotion-recognition/): Case study: a neural network that labels seven emotions in speech, trained on four public datasets. 93.87% on a random test split, with a live mic demo.
- [FastAPI OpenTelemetry tracing for an AI backend](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/observable-ai-backend/): Case study: a FastAPI AI server with LLM observability: request IDs in logs, Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry traces in Jaeger.
- [Regulatory obligation extraction with AI](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/obligation-management-system/): Case study: an AI service at Claptek that reads circulars, permits and regulations and returns obligations, each with a word-for-word source quote.
- [AI audit finding generator and drafting engine](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/ams-ai-finding-engine/): Case study: an AI audit finding generator at Claptek. It drafts three versions of each finding from checklist notes, and code checks block invented facts.
- [Text-to-SQL LLM assistant for core banking](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/core-banking-text-to-sql/): Case study: a text-to-SQL assistant at Claptek turning plain questions into Oracle queries over a 1,628-table bank database, on the bank's own servers.
- [AI scam honeypot that keeps scammers talking](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/agentic-honeypot/): Case study: an AI that plays an easily fooled target, keeps scammers talking and records the UPI payment IDs, links and phone numbers they reveal.
- [WhatsApp AI agent that replies in the background](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/whatsapp-ai-agent-platform/): Case study: a WhatsApp AI agent backend built in an internship for a client. FastAPI, Redis and Celery send AI replies in the background.
- [Deepfake video detection project](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/deepfake-video-detection/): Case study: a small neural network scores each video frame as real or fake, with a Streamlit app, confidence chart and PDF report. 74.16% test accuracy.
- [SMS spam classifier project built with Naive Bayes](https://shaunakchorge.github.io/Portfolio/new_portfolio/projects/spam-classifier/): SMS spam classifier project: TF-IDF and Naive Bayes on 5,169 text messages. 97.1% accuracy and no false alarms on 1,034 test messages.
